The map is under construction.\nPlease wait for the update.
Hm? A Hume adventurer and a Cule merchant?\nThat's rare... Well, it doesn't matter.
You can't go to El Scaro from here now.
Huh? Why?
Something big is blocking the way at the other\nside of the bridge. The plump body is moving up\nand down regularly, it might be a living thing...
What's that?
A napping spirit. It looks like a monster\nbut it's a god's messenger for Elves.\nI can't force it to get up. Sorry.
Uh-oh, an Elven spirit...\nThere's a rule that we must keep our hands off\neven if they are in the way...
Hmm, we can't help it.\nLet's go this way...
Hey, people other than Resistle need to receive\nthe blessing to go down that road.
Agh! Then we are stuck!!
And what the heck is the blessing thing?!\nAnyways, I'll do it if we can pass here.\nWhere can we do that?
Ha ha, I've got lots of questions.\nWell, it's one of the trials to find the place\nyou receive the blessing.
One thing I can say is...\nThe clues are on this hill.
That's it?!\nFine! We'll find out the place ourselves!\nLet's go!
Oh? It's pretty unusual to see Straye here...
Oh, sorry. My name is Delma.\nI live a quiet and secluded life here...\nPeople call me a recluse.
Well, nice to meet you.
By the way, what brings you here?
Let's ask him about the blessing...
I see. So, that's why you came here...\nThen, go to Ancient Empress's Tomb in Centerio\nHighlands to receive the blessing.
The soul of the Empress is there.\nActually, my ancestors served under the Empress.
What?! The soul of the Empress...\nT-That means... a ghost...?
Right.\nBut she's noble and beautiful.
How is it, do you have the courage to see her and\nreceive the blessing?
Sure!!
Um, ah...
Ha ha. ...Oh, I didn't mean to make fun of you.\nIt may take time to be prepared.\nCome to see me again when you are ready.
Hm, great.\nI'm sure she will give her blessing to brave\npeople who come to see her.
By the way, the tomb is locked, so take this.
You've got Tomb Key!
Oh, one more thing.\nThere are lots of evil spirits attracted to\nthe Empress's aura. So be careful.
And you have to be brave and polite in front of\nthe Empress. Got it?
Huh? Me?! But you said evil spirits...\nI-I kinda wanna stay here this time...
No! No! Nooooo!\nI hate ghosts! I hate spooks!! I hate phantoms!!!
But you can't enter the land of Resistle if\nyou don't receive the blessing.\nAre you sure you don't wanna do this?
...I knew it.\nI knew I have to do this...\nOkay, I'll go...
Wow, you're back safe!\nAnd you've received the blessing...
What? ...The Empress said so...?\nThank you, Your Majesty...
Anyway, you can enter the land of Resistle\nfrom now on.\nGood luck on your adventure.
The spirit is sleeping at the bridge entrance.\nYou are not allowed to wake it up...
Wait, wait. You are not allowed to pass here\nuntil you get the blessing.\nThere's no deadline, so just go get it.
The Empress used to govern the Empire that covered\nnearly half of the world.\nPeople loved her governing style.
But she passed away in an incident...\nAnd her spirit has been staying\nin the tomb since then.
...Huh? About the incident? Hmm...\nIt's a long story... It's really really long.\nI'll tell you when we have time for that.
Don't you have other things to do instead of\nvisiting a recluse like me? Well, you're welcomed.\nI'm glad to have the chance to talk with you.
...Have I lived here all this time, you asked?\nIt's been a long time, but I wasn't born here.
I'm the descendant of the general who served under\nthe Empress. I used to live in the Empire of\nTechnista and...Hm? You asked me why I'm here?
Well, to make a long story short, I was tired of\nseeing the people who tried to take advantage of\nmy family.
You should be careful, too.\nWhen you are admired and get full of youself,\nyou might get involved in a conspiracy...
Stop... It's you guys. Have you got the blessing?\nIt's no use lying. I can tell.
Oh, you really got the blessing.\nYou can pass here, then. Watch your steps.
